cms.support: Open-source software supported by a large community of developers and users. Official documentation and community forums are available.
cms.technology: PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports customizable themes, plugins, blogging, e-commerce, multimedia, custom templates, and website management.
cms.limitations: Requires regular updates to its core software, themes, and plugins. Poorly maintained plugins can create security risks.

cms.support: Open-source software maintained by the Drupal community. Users can access official documentation, community forums, and professional development services.
cms.technology: PHP, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, or SQLite, along with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports custom content types, themes, modules, user permissions, multilingual websites, workflows, and API integrations.
cms.limitations: Can be difficult for beginners to learn. Advanced customization and maintenance may require programming experience.

sources.name: The Russell Group Drupal Case Study

cms.support: Open-source software supported by the Joomla community. Users can access documentation, community forums, and third-party development services.
cms.technology: PHP, MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL, along with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports templates, extensions, multilingual websites, user management, content organization, and custom website features.
cms.limitations: Has a learning curve for beginners. Some advanced features require third-party extensions, which may need additional costs and maintenance.

cms.support: Commercial hosted platform supported by Shopify. Provides customer support, developer resources, and a community forum.
cms.technology: Cloud-hosted platform using Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON for theme development.
cms.capabilities: Supports online stores, product management, payment processing, inventory tracking, customizable themes, apps, and sales integrations.
cms.limitations: Requires a paid subscription. Some advanced features, themes, and third-party apps can involve additional costs.

cms.support: Open-source publishing platform developed by the Ghost Foundation. Offers community resources, official documentation, and paid managed hosting through Ghost(Pro).
cms.technology: Node.js, MySQL 8 for supported production hosting, Handlebars, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports website publishing, custom themes, memberships, paid subscriptions, email newsletters, analytics, and APIs.
cms.limitations: Primarily designed for publishing and membership websites. Advanced customization and self-hosting may require technical knowledge.

sources.name: Google News Initiative Ghost CMS Profile
